text:
Ben: Heads up from design review 1: the small in-console help popover uses 'Docs' in the header but the footer CTA says 'Learn more'. Feels inconsistent. Screenshot attached.
Sana: Nice catch. We decided in style guide that microcopy in-product should use 'Help' as the primary term; 'Docs' reserved for the external site. Recommend swapping to 'Help' and adding a clear crosslink labeled 'Open full docs' at the bottom.
Rohit: For tracking, can we append a utm-like param so analytics know it came from the popover? e.g. /docs/console/overview?src=popover_help
Jun: Yes, but please use a short param that we control: ?source=help-popover. Also mark link as external target=_blank + rel="noopener".
Maya: Accessibility issues I spotted:
- Popover lacks aria-expanded on trigger
- Dialog role missing: should be role="dialog" aria-modal="true"
- Close icon doesn't have aria-label (currently just an SVG button)
- Focus isn't restored to the trigger after close on keyboard tests
Ben: Good list. For copy, proposal: header = 'Help', subhead = short description, CTA = 'Open full docs (new tab)' with an external icon and a tooltip reading 'Opens in a new tab'.
Sana: Small UX ask: keep the popover slim (max-height 420px) and add a 'View in docs' affordance for long topics so users can deep-dive.
Rohit: I'll add the docs redirect and canonical slug so older links work: /docs/console/help-popover -> /docs/console/overview?source=help-popover. Will also emit an event help_popover.open and help_popover.docs_click in analytics.
Jun: Dev checklist I can take:
- add aria-label to close: <button aria-label="Close help panel">\u2715</button>
- ensure trigger has aria-expanded and aria-controls
- add role="dialog" aria-modal="true" to the container
- restore focus to trigger on close
- link target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer
Maya: Tests: add an accessibility test that tabs into the trigger, opens popover, tabs to close, presses Escape, and asserts document.activeElement === trigger. Also a visual contrast check for dark mode link text.
Ben: UX copy PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/3185 includes copy changes and the footer CTA language.
Sana: I'll update the design file (Figma) with the 'Help' header and new CTA microcopy, plus the external icon asset.
Rohit: I'll wire the redirect and analytics events. Jun can land the aria and focus restore changes.
Jun: I'll open a PR and tag the accessibility team. Draft branch: feature/help-popover-a11y.
Maya: One more nit: keyboard users expect Enter/Space on the trigger to open. Please include in keyboard handling tests.
Ben: Great. Can we aim to ship in next patch? If so let's mark this as a patch-hotfix and coordinate with releases.
Sana: Agreed. I'll add to the patch checklist and set a quick review slot.
Rohit: Will add server-side redirect and short analytics doc.
Jun: Will include acceptance tests in the PR and link them.
Maya: Thanks all. I'll follow up with a screenshot showing contrast adjustments for dark mode.
Ben: Thanks team. Closing thread once PR merged and analytics event received.
